# ferriskey_portal_active_theme (Resource)

Selects which portal theme is live for a realm (singleton per realm). Activation fails unless every page of the theme contains its required blocks. The API has no way to deactivate a theme: destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state and leaves the theme active.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_portal_active_theme" "this" {
  realm    = "acme"
  theme_id = ferriskey_portal_theme.brand.theme_id

  depends_on = [ferriskey_portal_theme_page.login]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `realm` (String) Realm whose active theme is managed. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `theme_id` (String) UUID of the `ferriskey_portal_theme` to activate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier (equal to `realm`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_portal_active_theme.this acme
```
